content:
kevin: Heads up — nightly SAST/DAST run flooded us with ~1.2k new findings. CI pipeline flagged as failing and attached evidence is inconsistent. Anyone own triage/evidence handoff for this?

maria: Yikes. Are these mostly fp noise from the new rule set we pushed yesterday? :eyes:

olga: I started sampling. Looks like a lot are duplicated callsites and two findings reference artifacts encrypted with the ephemeral keystore. Getting permission denied when I try to download evidence.

sec-bot: [scan-run] 3798765432 — nightly-scan: COMPLETED with 1203 findings (50 high, 200 med, 953 low). 3 attachment downloads failed: KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR

kevin: That's the KMS decrypt error I saw locally. The scanner SA probably lost kms:Decrypt after yesterday's RBAC change. Can infra confirm whether `scanner-service-account@proj` kept the CloudKMS cryptoKeyDecrypter role?

maria: @infra-team — can you check? We need evidence for repro and SLoC metrics. If SA can't decrypt, we must escalate otherwise triage blocked.

ashley: Quick workaround: I pulled the raw archive from the runner logs (where the scanner uploaded unencrypted to the temporary bucket) and attached a subset to the failing PRs. Not ideal long-term.

olga: Thanks ashley. We should also avoid manual leaks — let's sanitize before attaching. Also proposing a short runbook entry: 1) check SA IAM binding, 2) verify KMS key policy, 3) re-run scan w/ `--sync-artifacts` flag.

kevin: run command that failed (from runner):
```
./ci/run_sast.sh --project=redwood --target=prod --upload-artifacts
```
Runner logs show `ERROR: KMS decrypt failed for artifact metadata` around 03:12:04 UTC.

maria: Two asks: (A) someone to own audit-log backfill (we're missing requestPrincipal for a subset of scanner decrypt calls), (B) decide temporary triage owner for the 50 high findings. Suggest olga take the first pass and kevin to own the backfill request.

olga: I can do first-pass triage for high findings today. I'll drop a PR with a csv of repro steps + recommended label/owner mapping.

kevin: I'll open a support ticket with infra/keystore to request keystore audit log retrieval and confirm IAM bindings. Will paste ticket link here.

sec-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-0843 (kms-decrypt-failure) — assigned to infra-oncall. See https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0843

maria: Also can we add a CI guard to fail fast when scanner can't fetch artifacts? Right now pipeline shows success with missing evidence which hides triage failures.

ashley: Agreed. Suggested quick CI change: add `--require-artifact-decrypt` that makes scan job exit non-zero if any artifact fails to decrypt.

olga: I'll draft a short runbook patch and add to Security playbooks (link forthcoming). For now, triage plan: olga -> owns highs, ashley -> medium grouping automation, kevin -> logs/backfill.

kevin: Thanks. I'll update thread with infra ticket and any RBAC changes. If infra rebinds SA, re-run nightly and validate artifact downloads before we close the incident. :thumbsup:
